title: 署長職掌與施政重點
summary: 署長綜理署務並指揮監督所屬，副署長與主任秘書襄助；本頁說明署長職掌與年度施政重點。現任署長、副署長的學經歷見首長簡介。
bodyMarkdown:
## 署長職掌
依《衛生福利部疾病管制署組織法》，署長**綜理署務，並指揮、監督所屬人員**；置副署長二人、主任秘書一人襄助。疫情期間，署長依《傳染病防治法》協助中央流行疫情指揮中心運作。

> 本頁以職稱說明職掌，首長異動時毋須改版；現任署長、副署長的簡介（學歷、經歷、專長）見[首長簡介](/about/leadership/)。首長之公開行程與致詞請見新聞稿。

## 2026 年施政重點（示意）
1. **呼吸道傳染病整合防治**：流感、新冠疫苗同步接種與抗病毒藥物可近性。
2. **登革熱等蟲媒傳染病**：社區動員與跨國基因監測。
3. **消除結核病與愛滋**：主動發現、PrEP 與匿名篩檢。
4. **抗藥性防疫一體**：跨部門抗生素管理。
5. **數位轉型**：AI-ready 官網、開放資料與資料治理。

## 聯絡
對署長的意見請使用**署長信箱**，將依內容分流至權責單位處理。

en.title: Director-General: role and policy priorities
en.summary: The Director-General oversees all affairs of the agency, assisted by two deputies and a chief secretary; this page lists the role and 2026 priorities. Profiles of the current leaders are under Leadership.
en.bodyMarkdown:
## Role of the Director-General
Under the Organization Act of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Director-General **oversees all affairs of the agency and directs and supervises its staff**, assisted by two Deputy Directors-General and one Chief Secretary. During outbreaks, the Director-General supports the operation of the Central Epidemic Command Center under the Communicable Disease Control Act.

> This page describes the role by job title, so it does not need to change when leaders change; for profiles (education, experience and expertise) of the current Director-General and Deputy Directors-General, see [Leadership profiles](/en/about/leadership/). For public schedules and speeches of the leaders, see the press releases.

## 2026 policy priorities (illustrative)
1. **Integrated control of respiratory infections**: co-administration of influenza and COVID-19 vaccines and access to antivirals.
2. **Vector-borne diseases such as dengue**: community mobilisation and cross-border genomic surveillance.
3. **Eliminating tuberculosis and HIV**: active case finding, PrEP and anonymous screening.
4. **Antimicrobial resistance and One Health**: cross-sector antibiotic stewardship.
5. **Digital transformation**: AI-ready website, open data and data governance.

## Contact
Please use the **Director-General's mailbox** for comments to the Director-General; they will be routed to the responsible unit according to their content.
